title: These dharmas have the characteristic of emptiness
subtitle: A Heart Sutra passage on dharmas and emptiness
timeLabel: Heart Sutra Chinese translation and circulation context
shortSummary: The line places emptiness within a description of dharmas and helps demonstrate the relation among concept, passage and version layers.
curatorialDescription: The record does not translate emptiness directly as nothingness; interpretation will be shown with editions, commentaries and scholarly traditions.
researchNote: Variant readings, commentary traditions and English wording still need comparison.
